set.request: 3D paging system at /imagine/scenes/ using the vendored three.js: pages ARE scene nodes, click a 3D region to navigate, the /path/ bar reflects the scene location. Three swap grains (full scene, single object, region). At least one artistic themed experience mixing 2D chrome with 3D. Perf sane: one renderer, rAF paused when inactive, dispose on close.
steps: prove headless WebGL renders a canvas
build the Scene page base (one renderer, rAF, dispose)
path bar from chain(), deep-url cold load
set.outcome:
**A 3D pager at [/imagine/scenes/](/imagine/scenes/) — the page tree IS the scene graph.**

Every page owns one **slot** of the world and builds it; the active chain is the composition, walked root to leaf, deeper wins. That one rule is all three grains of swap, and because the world is *derived* from the chain rather than accumulated by clicks, a deep url cold-loads into exactly the state you reach by clicking.

![the region swap](grain-region-1920.png)

- [Worlds](/imagine/scenes/worlds/) — **full scene swap.** Dawn / Dusk / Deep out of one builder and three rows of numbers. Click the arch, the whole world goes.
- [Plinth](/imagine/scenes/plinth/) — **single object swap.** The room is the parent's slot; three children claim `focus`. The ring overhead never restarts, the camera never moves.
- [Quarters](/imagine/scenes/quarters/) — **region swap.** One plate, four corners, four slots. The beacon keeps its orbit across every change.
- Docs: [`readme.md`](/imagine/scenes/readme.md) · [`doc/slots.md`](/imagine/scenes/doc/slots.md) · [`doc/grains.md`](/imagine/scenes/doc/grains.md) · [`doc/decisions.md`](/imagine/scenes/doc/decisions.md)

**Verified headless** (SwiftShader WebGL, `--use-gl=angle --use-angle=swiftshader --enable-unsafe-swiftshader`): clicked a 3D object three hops deep, url + slots + camera changed each time; back and forward restore state; cold-load of the deep url matches the clicked-to state exactly; leaving the subtree freezes the frame counter (`running: false`) and re-entry restarts it; zero console errors at 400 / 1920 / 3440, no overflow at any width. Light and dark both — the canvas is transparent and the themed CSS box behind it is the sky.

Shots: hub [400](hub-400.png) · [1920](hub-1920.png) · [3440](hub-3440.png) · [dark](dark-1280.png) · the click hops [0](click-0-hub.png) [1](click-1-worlds.png) [2](click-2-dusk.png) [3](click-3-deep.png) vs the same url [cold](cold-3-deep.png).

**Left:** no OrbitControls (a dragged camera is state the url does not carry); no GLTF, though `/fly/spaceship.glb` would load; `Stage.dispose()` exists but nothing calls it — leaving stops the loop and keeps the context, and the disposal that matters happens on every slot swap. Not mine, seen while probing: `/imagine/page.js` declares a child named screens with no `page.js`, so two 404s fire on every page under `/imagine/`.
